known_limitations: Queue ownership is derived only from explicit owner fields; packages without an owner are marked unassigned and warned.
Dependency and blocker extraction is limited to explicit fields and labelled Markdown sections.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
summary: Implemented Assignment Queue v1 with JSON and Markdown outputs, CLI generation, dependency and blocker extraction, missing-owner warnings, tests, and generated current queue artifacts.
